title: EIGRP Neighbor Adjacency: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Two E I G R P routers sit on the same link. But they won't become neighbours. Check the five conditions.

scenes.heading: The fifteen door building
scenes.narration: To become neighbours, five things must line up. The A S number must match. They must be on the same subnet. The K values must match. Any authentication must match. And the interface must not be passive.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. Hostnames don't matter. Each router sets its own timers. You must also use the network command.

items.right: Router IDs just need to be unique

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva EIGRP adjacency lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Same A S, subnet, K values, authentication. The interface must not be passive. Hello is five seconds and hold is fifteen. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva EIGRP adjacency lab.
